purpose: Define the target schema and variables for a safe, non-production integration-canary testing database.
non_goals: Do not perform naming refactoring of existing variables or functions.
Do not execute live production migrations or writes.

required_secrets_without_values.CANARY_POSTGRES_HOST: Configure in GitHub integration-canary environment settings
required_secrets_without_values.CANARY_POSTGRES_PORT: Configure in GitHub integration-canary environment settings
required_secrets_without_values.CANARY_POSTGRES_USER: Non-production database user with DDL and DML access

required_fixtures: Sample metadata rows for test_db_export checks

validation_sequence: 3. Run optional live scrapers if enabled (test_scrapers_health.py)
4. Execute import canaries only if allow_db_import is true and confirmation is CANARY_NON_PROD_IMPORT

rollback_procedure.action: Drop database from OCI host to cleanup
